Reference input 1 props.png and reference input 2 scene.png are TWO LOCKED ORIGINAL STYLE ANCHORS, not content to copy. Match their observed natural-history ink and restrained warm earth wash. Top-down map view, slight side-face cheat, upper-left light. Crisp thin brown-black outside contour equivalent to 2px at 64px, sparse selective internal marks, broad muted two-tone planes. Strong instantly recognizable silhouette when displayed in a 64x64 tile and at 32x32. Centered object fills 75 percent of square canvas with generous empty margin, all parts uncropped. Completely transparent background; no ground plane, no cast ground shadow, no other objects, no text. No metal, no modern design, no photorealism, no 3D render, no dense crosshatching, no border.
